League of Legends tournament platform covering registration, live draft, bracket play, custom game lobbies, and match reporting. Built for organizers running competitive LoL tournaments end to end.

A comprehensive tournament platform for League of Legends. Covers tournament brackets, live draft and pick-ban, custom game lobbies, and match reporting, from registration to finals.

Project name: Sidequeue. Confirmed 2026-08-26.
Phase 0 and Phase 0.5 complete, awaiting review. Repo: https://github.com/hkemdesign/sidequeue (private).
Development key caps at 20 requests per second and 100 per 2 minutes, expires every 24 hours, and cannot power anything public, not even an open beta.

1. TypeScript only
2. No em dashes anywhere in generated content
3. Work in phases, confirm each phase before starting the next
4. Zod validation on every input
5. Every Supabase query scoped by RLS
6. Riot API key stays server-side only
7. All Riot API calls go through the throttled service layer
